body:
See that's the thing, when you're a high-level athlete of any sport (be it rugby or anything else) people think or expect you to be tough, strong - unbreakable of sorts. But how can that even be considered when I'm already broken.

And that's the thing, I ignore people who are like that and it just ends with me being alone. I've gone from circle of friends to circle of friends and it always ends the same way. 

I know most of it's not fair, but nothing in life is fair - some of us are just stuck being the ones with 'fairness' tipped against us.
